problem_statement.task: Does the page load correctly and run without errors?
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Open the browser developer tools Console panel 2. Load the page and wait for complete rendering 3. Check if the Console has any red error messages (JavaScript errors) 4. Check if the Network panel has any failed resource requests (404/500)
problem_statement.expected_result: Page loads completely, Console has no red errors, Network panel has no failed requests (404/500), all static resources (CSS/JS/images/fonts) load successfully
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 10 points; JavaScript runtime errors deduct 5 points; Resource 404 errors deduct 3 points; White screen or crash results in 0 points; Warnings only do not deduct points

problem_statement.task: Verify Job Creation Wizard functionality and feedback
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Click the 'Post a Job' button (Client view) 2. Complete the multi-step form (Title, Description, Skills, Budget) 3. Click 'Publish' and verify the transition or notification 4. Check if the new job appears in the public feed or dashboard list
problem_statement.expected_result: Wizard advances through steps correctly, form inputs work, clicking Publish triggers a success notification ('Your job is live'), and the job data is visually reflected in the UI
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 10 points; Wizard stuck on step deduct 4 points; Publish action fails/no feedback deduct 3 points; Job not appearing in list deduct 3 points

problem_statement.task: Test Hiring Flow: Proposal review and Contract creation
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Enter Client Dashboard and locate a Job with Proposals 2. Click a Proposal to view details and open Chat 3. Identify and click the 'Hire Now' button within the Chat interface 4. Verify fields for Milestone amount and Deposit are displayed
problem_statement.expected_result: Proposal details are visible, Chat interface opens correctly, 'Hire Now' button is accessible, and clicking it reveals the contract/deposit creation form (Escrow initiation UI)
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 10 points; Cannot view proposal details deduct 3 points; 'Hire Now' button missing/broken deduct 4 points; No deposit/milestone form deduct 3 points

problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Switch to Freelancer view and locate an 'Offer Received' or Active Contract 2. Click 'Accept Offer' (if applicable) then 'Submit Work' 3. Attach a dummy file (or simulate attachment) and confirm submission 4. Verify status changes to 'Awaiting Approval'
problem_statement.expected_result: User can accept offers, 'Submit Work' button opens submission interface, file attachment UI is present, and project status updates visually to 'Awaiting Approval' after submission
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 10 points; Cannot accept offer deduct 3 points; Submit button missing deduct 3 points; Status does not update deduct 4 points

problem_statement.task: Verify Dashboard Role Switching and View content
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Locate the User Menu or Role Toggle switch 2. Switch to 'Client' view and verify 'Active Job Postings' and 'New Proposals' counter 3. Switch to 'Freelancer' view and verify 'Job Feed' and 'Current Earnings' widget 4. Take screenshots of both views
problem_statement.expected_result: Role switching is seamless, Client view strictly shows postings/contracts, Freelancer view shows feed/earnings, content updates immediately without page reload failure
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 8 points; Role switch fails deduct 8 points; Content doesn't change/update deduct 4 points; Missing Earnings/Proposals widgets deduct 2 points

problem_statement.task: Test Payment Release and Escrow UI logic
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. As Client, navigate to a contract with 'Awaiting Approval' status 2. Click 'Approve & Release Payment' button 3. Verify visual confirmation of funds moving (e.g., wallet balance update or status change to 'Paid') 4. Check Transaction History if available
problem_statement.expected_result: Approval action is interactive, status changes from 'Awaiting Approval' to 'Paid' or similar, UI reflects the release of funds from Escrow
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 8 points; Approve button non-functional deduct 4 points; No status change visual deduct 2 points; No confirmation feedback deduct 2 points

problem_statement.task: Verify Chat Interface utilities and layout
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Open the Messaging/Chat section 2. Verify left sidebar conversation list and main chat history area 3. Locate and verify the 'Attachment' (paperclip) icon 4. Locate and verify the 'Video Call' integration button
problem_statement.expected_result: Chat layout follows spec (sidebar + main area), Attachment and Video Call buttons are visible and interactive (hover states/clickable)
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 8 points; Layout broken/missing sidebar deduct 3 points; Missing attachment icon deduct 2 points; Missing video call button deduct 2 points; Chat area not visible deduct 1 point

problem_statement.task: Verify Landing Page structure and Global Navigation
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Load the Landing Page (Public View) 2. Verify Hero section with tagline and Search bar 3. Scroll to check Categories Grid and 'Trusted by' section 4. Check Global Header for Logo, Navigation Links, and Login/User menu
problem_statement.expected_result: Landing page contains Hero with correct tagline, Search input is present, Categories grid displays skills, Header contains all specified links and responsive elements
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 6 points; Missing Hero/Search deduct 2 points; Missing Categories/Trust section deduct 2 points; Navigation incomplete deduct 2 points

problem_statement.task: Test Profile Portfolio Grid and Modal interaction
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Navigate to a User Profile page 2. Scroll to the Portfolio section 3. Click on a project thumbnail 4. Verify a modal opens displaying project description and detailed images
problem_statement.expected_result: Portfolio section displays a grid of thumbnails, clicking opens a functional modal (overlay), modal contains details, closing the modal works correctly
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 5 points; No portfolio section deduct 3 points; Modal doesn't open deduct 2 points; Modal content empty deduct 1 point

problem_statement.task: Evaluate whether the interface visual design meets professional design standards
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. View the webpage screenshot to assess whether the overall color scheme is harmonious 2. Check if the layout spacing is reasonable (whether element spacing follows the 8px multiple principle) 3. Check if the typography system is professional (body font size ≥14px, line height exceeds 1.5x)
problem_statement.expected_result: The interface follows modern design principles: harmonious and unified color scheme, reasonable and standardized layout spacing, professional and clear typography system
problem_statement.criteria: Deduct 5 points for each instance of crowded visual elements, deduct 6 points for jarring color combinations, deduct 5 points for chaotic text and image layout

problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Take a screenshot of the Dashboard or main content area 2. Verify Background is Pale Orchid (approx #E6D8E6) 3. Verify Content Containers are Deep Purple (approx #4A148C) 4. Verify Primary Action Buttons are Bright Magenta (approx #D500F9)
problem_statement.expected_result: Design strictly follows the specified palette: Orchid background, Deep Purple cards, and Magenta buttons. High contrast is maintained.
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 10 points; Background not Orchid/Lavender deduct 3 points; Containers not Deep Purple deduct 3 points; Buttons not Magenta deduct 2 points; Inconsistent theme usage deduct 2 points

problem_statement.task: Verify Typography and Contrast within Dark Containers
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Inspect text inside the Deep Purple content blocks 2. Verify text color is White or Very Light Lavender for readability 3. Check Input fields are White background with Dark text 4. Verify Font is a rounded Sans-Serif (e.g., Nunito/Quicksand)
problem_statement.expected_result: Text on purple backgrounds is white/light (high readability), Input fields are white boxes inside purple containers, Font family matches rounded sans-serif style
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 5 points; Dark text on Dark background (unreadable) deduct 3 points; Input fields wrong style deduct 1 point; Wrong font style deduct 1 point

instruction:
# Web page content
### 1. Global Navigation & Layout Structure
*   **Header/Navigation Bar:**
    *   **Logo:** Located on the top left.
    *   **Primary Menu:** "Find Work" (for Freelancers), "My Jobs," "Reports," "Messages."
    *   **Search Bar:** Global search input for finding jobs or freelancers.
    *   **User Menu:** Avatar/Profile picture with a dropdown for Settings, Profile, and Logout.
    *   **Notification Bell:** Indicator for new messages, job offers, or payment statuses.
*   **Footer:** Links to Help Center, Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and Social Media icons.
*   **Mobile Adaptation:** On mobile devices, the header simplifies to a logo and hamburger menu, with a fixed bottom navigation bar for core actions (Home, Search, Messages, Profile).

### 2. Landing Page (Public View)
*   **Hero Section:** High-impact tagline ("Find the perfect professional for your project"), "Hire" and "Work" toggle buttons, and a primary search field.
*   **Categories Grid:** Icons and text links for major skills (e.g., Development, Design, Writing, Marketing).
*   **Social Proof:** "Trusted by" section with logos of fictitious partner companies or user testimonials.

### 3. User Dashboard (Private View)
*   **Client View:**
    *   **Active Job Postings:** List of currently open jobs with a counter for "New Proposals."
    *   **Active Contracts:** Cards showing ongoing projects, freelancers hired, and milestone progress.
*   **Freelancer View:**
    *   **Job Feed:** Algorithmic list of recommended jobs based on skills.
    *   **Active Proposals:** Status of sent applications (Viewed, Interviewing, Archived).
    *   **Current Earnings:** Summary widget showing "Pending Clearance" and "Available for Withdrawal" balances.

### 4. Job Posting & Management
*   **Job Creation Wizard:** A multi-step form (Title, Description, Category, Skill Tags, Budget Type (Hourly/Fixed), Duration).
*   **Job Detail Page:** Full description, client verified status (payment method verified), budget, and a clear "Apply Now" button.
*   **Proposal List (Client side):** List of applicants showing Freelancer Name, Bid Amount, Cover Letter snippet, and "Match Score."

### 5. Profile & Portfolio
*   **Header:** Cover image, Profile photo, Name, Title (e.g., "Senior UX Designer"), and Hourly Rate.
*   **Stats Bar:** Job Success Score (%), Total Earnings, Hours Worked.
*   **Portfolio Section:** Grid of project thumbnails; clicking opens a modal with detailed project descriptions and images.
*   **Reviews:** List of past client feedback with star ratings.

### 6. Messaging & Collaboration
*   **Chat Interface:** Left sidebar for conversation list; main area for chat history.
*   **Utilities:** File attachment (paperclip icon), "Create Offer" button (for clients within chat), and Video Call integration button.

### 7. Payments & Wallet
*   **Transaction History:** Table showing Date, Description, Amount, and Status.
*   **Methods:** Interface to link Credit Cards (Client) or Bank Accounts/PayPal (Freelancer).

---
# web page interaction
### 1. Interaction Logic & Rules
*   **Role Logic:** Users can switch between "Client" and "Freelancer" modes within the same account, or must select a primary role at registration.
*   **Messaging Restrictions:** To prevent spam, freelancers generally cannot initiate a message to a client unless the client has replied to their proposal or sent an invitation.
*   **Escrow Logic (The "Game" Economy):**
    *   **Rule:** Money is never sent directly from Client to Freelancer instantly.
    *   **Flow:** Client deposits funds $\rightarrow$ Platform holds in Escrow $\rightarrow$ Freelancer completes work $\rightarrow$ Client approves work $\rightarrow$ Platform releases funds to Freelancer.
*   **Winning Conditions (Job Completion):** A job is considered "Won" (Completed) when the freelancer submits the required deliverables and the client clicks "Approve & Release Payment."

### 2. Interaction Action Sequences

**Sequence A: The Hiring Flow (Client Perspective)**
1.  **Trigger:** User clicks "Post a Job."
2.  **Action:** User fills out the 3-step wizard and clicks "Publish."
3.  **System Response:** Job appears in the public feed; Client receives notification "Your job is live."
4.  **Interaction:** Client receives a notification: "New Proposal from [User]."
5.  **Action:** Client clicks notification, views proposal, and clicks "Message."
6.  **Action:** Client is satisfied with the chat, clicks "Hire Now" button within the chat window, defines the milestone amount, and deposits funds.
7.  **System Response:** Contract is created; Freelancer receives "Offer Received" alert.

**Sequence B: The Work & Payment Flow (Freelancer Perspective)**
1.  **Trigger:** Freelancer receives "Offer Received" notification.
2.  **Action:** Freelancer clicks "Accept Offer."
3.  **System Response:** Project status changes to "Active." Timer/Milestone tracker becomes enabled.
4.  **Action:** Freelancer completes task, goes to Project Dashboard, attaches files, and clicks "Submit Work for Payment."
5.  **System Response:** Status changes to "Awaiting Approval." Client is notified.
6.  **Action:** Client approves.
7.  **Result:** Funds move from "Escrow" to Freelancer's "Available Balance."

---
# web page visual
### 1. Color Palette & Theme
*   **Core Concept:** A "Royal Digital" aesthetic that feels creative yet professional.
*   **Background:**
    *   **Main Background:** **Pale Orchid** (Hex approx: `#E6D8E6` to `#F3E5F5`). A very soft, desaturated lavender/orchid shade to ensure eye comfort for long reading sessions.
    *   **Visual Texture:** Subtle geometric patterns or soft gradients fading from Orchid to White to add depth without clutter.
*   **Content Blocks (Cards/Containers):**
    *   **Primary Containers:** **Deep Purple** (Hex approx: `#4A148C` or `#6A1B9A`). These blocks will hold the main content.
    *   **Contrast Handling:** Because the content blocks are dark purple, all text inside these blocks must be **White** or **Very Light Lavender** for high readability.
    *   **Alternative Containers (for less emphasis):** White backgrounds with a **Purple Border** (2px solid) to maintain the theme without making the page too dark.

### 2. Typography & Iconography
*   **Font:** A modern, rounded Sans-Serif (e.g., *Nunito* or *Quicksand*) to match the friendly "Orchid" vibe.
*   **Headings:** Bold, White text (when on Purple blocks) or Dark Purple text (when on Orchid background).
*   **Icons:** Line-art style icons.
    *   **Active State:** Filled White.
    *   **Inactive State:** Semi-transparent White (on purple blocks) or Dark Purple (on background).

### 3. Component Styling
*   **Buttons:**
    *   **Primary Action (e.g., "Post Job", "Accept"):** **Bright Magenta/Fuchsia** (Hex approx: `#D500F9`). This provides a striking contrast against the Deep Purple content blocks.
    *   **Secondary Action:** Transparent background with a White border (Ghost button style).
*   **Inputs/Forms:**
    *   Fields should have a White background with dark text to ensure standard usability, sitting inside the Purple content blocks.
*   **Feedback Indicators:**
    *   **Success:** A bright Teal/Cyan (to contrast with purple).
    *   **Error:** A bright Coral/Orange (red clashes with purple/orchid).

### 4. Visual Hierarchy Example
*   *Imagine the Dashboard:* The screen has a soft Orchid background. In the center, there is a large, rounded card (Deep Purple). Inside this card, "Active Jobs" is written in bold White text. Below the title, individual job rows are separated by thin lavender lines. The "View" button next to a job is a popping Bright Magenta.
